Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

The petitioner vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seeks quashing of FIR No.114/2021 dated 06.04.2021 registered under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Neb Sarai, District South, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom.
2. This petition is supported by affidavits of the petitioner and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3. Petitioner and as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
CRL.M.C. 7750/2023 page 1 of 2 This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 00:30:28 5.
Learned APP accepts notice.
He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 20.05.2023.
She further states that she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.

7. In view of the fact that the petitioner and the respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by Hemraj vs The State (Nct Of Delhi) & Anr on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128886115/

8. Accordingly, the present petition is allowed and FIR No.114/2021 dated 06.04.2021 registered under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Neb Sarai, District South, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom are quashed.
9. Accordingly, the present petition stands disposed of.
